name: reclip
description: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
one_liner: A simple self-hosted web app for downloading videos or audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and about a thousand other sites.
buyer: Honestly a personal-use tool for individuals who want their own downloader instead of using sketchy ad-covered websites — there isn't a clean commercial buyer here.
business_use_cases: A social media manager self-hosts it to save reference clips for internal use.
A hobbyist archives their own content or public-domain material for offline viewing.

money_ideas.idea: None that hold up honestly — reselling access to a video downloader runs straight into the terms of service (and often copyright) of the sites it downloads from.

steal_this: Not a real business starter — dozens of free clones of this already exist and monetizing it invites takedown and legal risk. Fine as a personal tool, not a weekend business.
